# The key set and the value types each SCHEMA_VERSION writes (`PROSE-029`).
#
# One section per version, one line per path, each naming the type the value
# under it holds. `*` stands for a tree node, and `t:*` for a block body: their
# names carry a TreeID. `@` marks an inline mark laid over the body.
#
# Generated by `logic::schema_shape`, never by hand. A section is frozen: a
# build whose shape no longer matches its own section raises SCHEMA_VERSION and
# appends a new section. Editing a section in place is the one move this file
# exists to make visible in review.

== v1

annots/*/anchor_end: i64
annots/*/anchor_start: i64
